layout.tooltip: Detailed shows every window per service; Compact shows one gauge per service.

compact-window.tooltip: Which window Compact shows. Tightest picks whichever has the least left. Services without the chosen window fall back to their tightest.

orientation.tooltip: Landscape makes the card wider and puts services in two columns side by side.

show-errored.tooltip: Off hides services whose last refresh failed instead of showing them dimmed.
